problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: size 68 cubic meters
* Shipment Beta: size 47 cubic meters
* Shipment Gamma: size 54 cubic meters
* Shipment Delta: size 67 cubic meters
* Shipment Epsilon: size 39 cubic meters
* Shipment Zeta: size 70 cubic meters
* Shipment Eta: size 38 cubic meters
* Shipment Theta: size 31 cubic meters
* Shipment Iota: size 34 cubic meters
* Shipment Kappa: size 41 cubic meters
* Shipment Lambda: size 32 cubic meters
* Shipment Mu: size 50 cubic meters
* Shipment Nu: size 68 cubic meters
* Shipment Xi: size 53 cubic meters
* Shipment Omicron: size 63 cubic meters
* Shipment Pi: size 59 cubic meters
* Shipment Rho: size 57 cubic meters
* Shipment Sigma: size 42 cubic meters
* Shipment Tau: size 55 cubic meters
* Shipment Upsilon: size 33 cubic meters
* Shipment Phi: size 52 cubic meters
* Shipment Chi: size 62 cubic meters
* Shipment Psi: size 54 cubic meters
* Shipment Omega: size 59 cubic meters
* Shipment Atlas: size 66 cubic meters
* Shipment Apollo: size 68 cubic meters
* Shipment Ares: size 55 cubic meters
* Shipment Artemis: size 66 cubic meters
* Shipment Hermes: size 46 cubic meters
* Shipment Hera: size 68 cubic meters
* Shipment Zeus: size 67 cubic meters
* Shipment Poseidon: size 37 cubic meters
* Shipment Dionysus: size 70 cubic meters
* Shipment Demeter: size 41 cubic meters
* Shipment Hades: size 48 cubic meters
* Shipment Hephaestus: size 40 cubic meters
* Shipment Aphrodite: size 70 cubic meters
* Shipment Athena: size 65 cubic meters
* Shipment Chronos: size 67 cubic meters
* Shipment Nike: size 64 cubic meters

Each cargo plane has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic meters. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes possible. Each shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total size of shipments on any plane cannot exceed its capacity limit.
